program.source: Fresh admission depth and review; current pose supplied by host

departure_gate.action: At most 40 mm upward, fixed orientation, keep gripper
departure_gate.rationale: Positive conservative finger clearance plus positive departure direction; no required pre-existing retention or renewed closure overlap.

program.objective: Upward differential retention test; no lateral transport, reopening or repeated closure

state.feature_source: GPT-authored program; not an independent sensor

x.instructions: For axis x, read state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation only. Choose positive for increase, negative for decrease, and hold for within_tolerance. Other axes do not determine this answer. Program-authored policy: For the x world axis, read its trusted goal_relation and pose residual. Follow increase/decrease/within_tolerance. This is an admitted upward-only local test, not permission to find objects or change goals.

criteria.negative: Decrease this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component when its relation is decrease.
criteria.hold: No component correction when its relation is within_tolerance.
criteria.positive: Increase this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component when its relation is increase.

gripper.instructions: For the gripper question, read state.processed_features.objective.gripper and deliver that requirement. Program-authored policy: Read objective.gripper. Preserve the already executed grasp throughout this test; do not infer retention from closure.

criteria.open: Deliver open only for an explicit open objective.
criteria.close: Deliver close only for an explicit close objective.
criteria.keep: Preserve the current gripper command for the keep objective.
